candidates.title: CIEMAT-QI4X: a reactor-relevant quasi-isodynamic stellarator configuration compatible with an island divertor
candidates.notes: Dec 2025 paper by Sánchez et al. (CIEMAT). Abstract explicitly states: 'small bootstrap current and an edge island structure compatible with an island divertor.' Four-field-period QI configuration, 4/4 island chain at edge resilient up to β=4% even with bootstrap current included. Directly relevant to G-12 and to Section 3a (alpha confinement in QI configurations). Extracted as abstract-level content (86 lines).

candidates.title: Quasi-isodynamic stellarators with low turbulence as fusion reactor candidates
candidates.notes: May 2024 paper by Goodman et al. (IPP Greifswald). Combines plasma stability, fast-ion confinement, and turbulence reduction in QI designs. Triage of HTML version confirmed quantitative data: bootstrap current coefficient |D₃₁*| < 0.01 (negligible values), total bootstrap current < 10 kA, neoclassical transport ε_eff³/² lower than W7-X STD. Extracted as abstract-level content (77 lines). Full paper content not captured by trafilatura (abstract page only).

entries.note: Two arXiv papers extracted as abstract-level sources confirming QI stellarator bootstrap current is near-zero by design. Full paper PDFs not captured — a future iteration should attempt arxiv.org/pdf/2512.08825 or arxiv.org/pdf/2405.19860 directly.
